queries.text: Why did a US court find Google's search business a monopoly, and what remedies were ordered?
Number of US federal judges who ruled in favor of the DOJ and state AGs on specific antitrust claims against Google's search business
Percentage share of global desktop web browser market held by Chrome as reported by StatCounter or NetApplications for 2019-2023
Annual revenue generated from Google Search advertising services compared to total Alphabet Inc. net income for fiscal years 2018 through 2022

Count of exclusive distribution agreements between Google and mobile device manufacturers (OEMs) that pre-installed Google Search as default, specifically involving Apple iPhone and Samsung Galaxy devices
Median monthly payment amount paid by Google to Apple under their search partnership agreement per query or user session during the period covered in court filings
Number of state attorneys general who filed amicus briefs supporting the DOJ's motion for specific performance remedies regarding browser unbundling
Percentage change in Google Search market share in the US following the announcement of the antitrust ruling versus the year prior
List of specific structural remedies proposed by Judge Amit Mehta including divestiture requirements for Chrome browser or Android operating system components

search_hits.title: The Google search-monopoly remedies (2024-2025)
search_hits.snippet: Judge Amit Mehta ruled Google a search monopolist on 2024-08-05; structural remedies followed on 2025-08-05.
